title: itf-linker: orbit fitting and linkage triage for the MPC Isolated Tracklet File
description: A Python pipeline over the Minor Planet Center's Isolated Tracklet File — roughly 9.3 million astrometric observations never linked to any orbit. Parses the MPC 1992 80-column format including two-line space-based records, reconstructs tracklets, screens for reused tracklet identifiers, and fits orbits via Find_Orb against the MPC's published identification acceptance criteria. Find_Orb integration is validated by a closed loop against JPL Horizons. All submission paths are gated behind human review.
